mentions.name: butterflyz
mentions.description: A Bluesky client that uses on-device AI to organize and summarize the contents of your feeds so you can find interesting posts faster, with a choice among dozens of models. It also focuses on usable screen space on small-screen devices, aiming for a superior look and feel to the default client.
mentions.problem: Sifting through Bluesky feeds to find interesting posts is slow; the client uses on-device AI to organize and summarize feed content so you can find the interesting posts faster.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on a Bluesky client that uses on-device AI to organize and summarize the contents of your feeds, so you can find the interesting posts faster. You can choose among dozens of models.
